title: Ultra-high-pressure liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry method for the determination of 9 organophosphate flame retardants in water samples
author: Lorenzo, Campo, et al.
materials: Ultra-high-pressure liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (UHPLC-QqQ-MS/MS) is likely the most promising platform for the determination of PFRs in water and wastewater matrices [1], [2], [3], [4], [5]. However, the presence of some interferences from the dissolvent, the equipment and the laboratory material can disturb their analytical determination. We made, up to our knowledge, the first determination of PFRs using a trap column to distinguish these interferences. Furthermore, we prove two different solvents, acetonitrile (ACN) and methanol (MeOH), observing the presence of analyte’s contamination in both cases. The system is applied to the determination of PFR in water.

(a)Put the Phenomenex Strata-X 33u Polymeric Reversed Phase (200 mg/6 mL) cartridges (Phenomenex, Torrance, Ca, USA) into a 12 port vacuum manifold Supelco Visiprep 57030-U de Sigma-Aldrich (St. Louis, MO, EEUU).(b)Precondition the cartridge with 6 mL MeOH:DCM (1:1 v/v), 6 mL of MeOH and 6 mL of water, with 350 mba/h·PA vacuum.(c)Pass the water samples through the cartridges under previous vacuum at a flow rate of 10 mL/min.(d)Dry the cartridges under vacuum for 15 min.(e)Elute the analytes on a 15 mL Falcon tube VWR (Radnor, PA, USA) with 10 mL of MeOH:DCM (50:50 v/v).(f)Evaporate the extracts to dryness at 40 °C using a combined sample concentrator model SBHCONC/1 and a heating plate model SBH130D/3 both manufactured by Stuart (Stafford, UK).(g)Redissolve the residue in 1 mL of methanol by agitation and ultrasonication for 1 min and pass the extract to 2 mL amber vials with 250 μL insert polypropylene 100/PK + Septum Sil/PTFE, both manufactured by Análisis Vínicos S.L. (Tomelloso, Spain).

steps.title: Prepare internal standard solution
steps.instruction: Add the internal standard mixture to water to achieve 200 ng L⁻¹, which will correspond to 50 ng mL⁻¹ in the final injected extract; keep total organic solvent addition ≤250 μL and use only plastic containers to avoid glass adsorption.

steps.title: Condition SPE cartridges
steps.instruction: Place Phenomenex Strata‑X 33 µ (200 mg/6 mL) cartridges into a Supelco Visiprep 57030‑U 12‑port vacuum manifold; pre‑condition each cartridge sequentially with 6 mL MeOH:DCM (1:1 v/v), 6 mL MeOH, and 6 mL water under 350 mbar vacuum.

steps.title: Load sample onto SPE
steps.instruction: Pass the water sample through the conditioned cartridges under the same vacuum at a flow rate of 10 mL min⁻¹.

steps.title: Dry SPE cartridges
steps.instruction: Maintain vacuum on the cartridges for 15 min to dry them.

steps.title: Elute analytes from SPE
steps.instruction: Elute with 10 mL MeOH:DCM (50:50 v/v) directly into a 15 mL Falcon tube (VWR).

steps.title: Evaporate eluate to dryness
steps.instruction: Evaporate the eluate to dryness at 40 °C using a Stuart SBHCONC/1 concentrator coupled with a SBH130D/3 heating plate.

steps.title: Reconstitute dried extract
steps.instruction: Redissolve the residue in 1 mL methanol by vortex agitation and 1 min ultrasonication; transfer the solution to a 2 mL amber vial equipped with a 250 μL polypropylene insert (100/PK) and a Sil/PTFE septum (Análisis Vínicos S.L.).

steps.title: Prepare calibration standards
steps.instruction: Prepare seven PFR standard solutions in methanol covering concentrations from the LOQ up to 300 ng mL⁻¹, each containing 50 ng mL⁻¹ of the corresponding deuterated internal standard.

steps.title: Determine LOD and LOQ
steps.instruction: Spike river water at 4 ng L⁻¹ and wastewater at 100 ng L⁻¹, analyze, and calculate LOD as the amount giving S/N = 3:1 and LOQ as S/N = 10:1 using MassHunter Workstation; reported LODs correspond to 0.12–1 ng L⁻¹ and LOQs to 1.2–10 ng L⁻¹ in water samples.

steps.title: Assess method precision
steps.instruction: Analyze five replicates of water extracts spiked at 400 ng L⁻¹ within a single day (intra‑day) and on separate days (inter‑day); calculate %RSD, which should be ≤11.4 % intra‑day and ≤20 % inter‑day; also perform quintuplicate spiked samples at 400 ng L⁻¹ for recovery assessment.

steps.title: Evaluate method robustness
steps.instruction: Intentionally vary each of the following by ±20 %: sample water volume, SPE flow‑rate, cartridge drying time, and eluent composition; verify that analytical results remain statistically comparable to the validated method.

steps.title: Run QC blanks
steps.instruction: For every ten analytical samples, inject one instrumental blank and one procedural blank; ensure the blanks display only the two characteristic peaks (TClPP from river water and instrumental background) to confirm absence of cross‑contamination.
